# M4 authored KAG scene

The first-party configuration and scenarios are GPL-2.0-or-later. They use the
complete pinned KAG3 scripts, ordinary horizontal Noto text, instantaneous PNG
changes, two link branches, a macro, embedded TJS, cross-file call/return and
PCM16 WAV playback. Configuration disables desktop menus, movies and persistence;
M5 owns game-state save/load. The framework is neither trimmed nor replaced.

Run `python scripts/create_krkr_m4_fixtures.py --output .agent-work/m4-acceptance/games`
to copy the pinned framework and generate authored PNG/WAV assets plus compressed
XP3 and error samples. Generated game trees carry KAG3's original license and
source identity. No commercial game data or generated binaries are committed.
